title: Draft in Parallel, Condition Through Depth: Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.36173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parallel speculative drafting generates multiple candidates in one backbone pass, but independent token selection can produce inconsistent continuations that shorten the accepted prefix. Existing methods mostly leave conditional decoding to a lightweight module after the backbone, which limits the flow of predecessor information to successors. Our analysis of DFlash shows that early positions already form recoverable predictions in shallow layers, and that accurate adjacent predecessors help successors more when they enter earlier. We therefore propose DSpine, a drafter with causal conditioning injection throughout the backbone: at every layer, gated adjacent injection writes each predecessor's predicted feature into its successor, so the causal conditioning chain unfolds over network depth while all positions update in parallel. translated_title: 并行草拟，深度条件化：面向推测解码的相邻因果注入
translated_abstract: 并行推测草拟在一次骨干网络前向传播中生成多个候选，但各token的独立选择可能产生不一致的后续内容，从而缩短被接受的前缀长度。现有方法大多将条件化解码交给骨干网络之后的轻量级模块完成，这限制了前驱信息向后继位置的传递。我们对DFlash的分析表明，靠前的位置在浅层中就已经形成可恢复的预测，且准确的相邻前驱信息越早进入，对后继的帮助越大。因此，我们提出DSpine——一种在整个骨干网络中贯穿进行因果条件注入的草拟器：在每一层，门控相邻注入将每个前驱的预测特征写入其后继位置，使因果条件链随网络深度逐层展开，同时所有位置仍保持并行更新。一个由目标模型输出嵌入构建的统一迁移空间，将逐层注入与……统一在一起（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DSpine草拟器，通过在骨干网络每一层进行门控相邻因果注入，将前驱的预测特征逐层写入后继位置，使因果条件链随网络深度展开、所有位置并行草拟，从而生成更一致的候选并提升推测解码的接受前缀长度。
en_tdlr: DSpine is a speculative decoding drafter that performs gated adjacent causal injection at every backbone layer, writing each predecessor's predicted feature into its successor so the causal conditioning chain unfolds through network depth while all positions draft in parallel, yielding more consistent candidates and longer accepted prefixes.
